d: Chestnut brown hair, shoulder-length with a side-swept fringe and a wavy texture. Bright sapphire blue eyes with a determined expression. An apparent age of a young adult in her early twenties. A slender, athletic build. A cohesive ensemble of deep navy blue and pale silvery-blue armor, featuring a breastplate, a belted waist, and a long flowing skirt with golden fleur-de-lis embroidery.
